# Rusty

## Overview

- **Nicknames:** Rusty Coat  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044)</sub>

## Appearance

Rusty is a character who has lost another piece of his ear by Volume 3. His physical appearance reflects these missing ear pieces.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000)_

## Personality

Rusty is a privileged cat who is described as a fighter by nature. Because of this temperament, it is expected that he would constantly fight with other cats if kept in the same household.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023), [v3 ch.Dawn P7](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0007)_

## History

Rusty was a stray cat who unexpectedly adopted [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her sophomore year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), remaining with her at Patty's Place after a failed attempt by the girls to humanely euthanize him. Upon the arrival of Aunt Jamesina's pets, Rusty attempted to assert dominance over the household's new animals; he was swiftly defeated by the Sarah-cat and engaged in ongoing skirmishes with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) until the two eventually became friends. He also engaged in a pitched battle where he routed the tobacco-king's cat.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P3](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0003), [v3 ch.Relationships P7](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0007), [v3 ch.Relationships P9](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0009), [v3 ch.Relationships P15](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0015), [v3 ch.Relationships P16](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0016), +247 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rusty.md)

Rusty adopted [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when he arrived as a stray at Patty's Place during her sophomore year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Although the household initially attempted to humane-euthanize him, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decided to keep him. Since then, Rusty has grown deeply affectionate toward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and loves only her.

- Friend of — affectionate towards her and loves only her  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P48](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0048), [v3 ch.Opens P1](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0001)</sub>

### [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

When [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) brought [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) to Patty's Place, Rusty attempted to assert dominance over the new cats. This led to ongoing skirmishes between Rusty and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md). Eventually, their fighting ceased, and the two became sworn friends who peacefully share the same cushion.

- Friend of — became sworn friends after fighting, sleeping on the same cushion  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)</sub>
